# AuraStudio — Visual AI Workflow Studio
> Canonical URL: https://aurastudio.devamit.co.in/
> Architect: Amit Chakraborty (devamit)
> Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node-based Graph Execution

## Overview
AuraStudio is a visual node-based AI workflow automation studio and visual pipeline orchestrator. It empowers engineers and creators to build, test, and deploy multi-model pipelines chaining OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Google Gemini 2.0, RAG search, and webhooks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Visual Canvas Pipeline Builder**: Drag-and-drop reactive graph nodes with real-time execution feedback.
- **Multi-LLM Orchestration**: Interoperable prompts, temperature, structured JSON output validation, and fallback chains.
- **RAG & Knowledge Retrieval**: Vector embeddings, chunking, and similarity ranking directly on the execution graph.
- **Self-Hosting & Local Execution**: Zero-lockin, offline runner, and portable pipeline JSON export.
